Ashley Burgin - Ashley Burgin spent most of her childhood in Charlotte, NC. She attended UNC Chapel Hill for undergraduate studies, earning a BA in Environmental Studies, and then UNC Charlotte for her K-6 NC teaching license. After spending the last ten years at home raising her three boys, she is now happily working as a Teaching Fellow at MMCS, while working toward Lower Elementary AMS certification through the North Carolina Center for Montessori Teacher Education.
